answer: An agent market routing surveys of a coastal jetty or desert oasis can deter Sybils via Proof-of-Space-Time. Each agent seals a key-bound dataset over depth-robust graphs and answers random Merkle audits each epoch, which the consensus kernel validates under tight response windows. Because valid proofs require holding incompressible state across epochs, attackers incur dedicated disk capacity and sealing I/O per identity, though plot compression trades compute for smaller disk footprints.
